name: Jinno Ai
source:
"Being reunited like this with Akito-san is definitely not an accident. I'm sure God destined for this to happen..."

An honor student who attends a famous all girls school. Has good grades, excels at sports and has a face and figure with no faults. She's like the leader of her school. She used to play with Akito when she was young, but after she went to school and lived in the dorm, they haven't met even once. She hates her father who left her and Sumire alone. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.alicesoft.com/tsumamigui3/chara/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
